limitations: The reference validates owner-derived default output paths only. It does not discover every writer, run native profiling, inspect actual output contents or prove evidence validity.
The reproduction verifies the inspected default path literals in the actual committed producer ASTs; it does not execute those producers.
Canonical lexical paths are not a filesystem sandbox. Existing symlink containment, owned cleanup and private diagnostic controls remain necessary.
An exception reason is a reviewable retained constraint, not authorization or proof that the tradeoff is worthwhile.
This policy does not change schemas, preserve/drop decisions, source identities, historical receipts or user-selected output destinations.
